desc:
Start as a skinny nobody on the Shore. Leave as the Boardwalk King.

Knock out meatheads and steal their fans. Take them back to your crib, where they party and pay you every second. Knock out another player and their fans are up for grabs too.

Hit the gym bench and workout to get huge. Buy swag to boost your aura. Build up your crib with a pool, a cabana, a stage and more.

The bigger you get, the bigger the fans you can pull, from Tourists all the way to Celebrities. Climb the ranks: Wannabe, Gym Bro, Jacked, Diesel, Beast, Shore Legend, Boardwalk King.

Big Sal will show you around. After that, the Shore is yours.
